notes: THE 21 SECONDS WERE THE CONNECTION, NOT THE LIBRARY. Every fresh search of a folder took 21 seconds while the libraries answered in a third of a second: a dropped first connection attempt, which Windows retries after 3, 6 and 12 seconds, and a sweep waits for its slowest connection; downloads stalled the same way. Every request of the run now goes through a connection whose connect is abandoned after 3 seconds and tried again at once, so a dropped attempt costs 3 seconds instead of 21. Since 1.3.78: Pixabay asked two categories a page, the card's own first; since 1.3.77: the page says where it is during the verify and tile passes; since 1.3.76: the footage starts beside the first stage the Run actually runs.
